title: The Distant Vector
author: Petra Dunmore
blurb: Yara Iversen, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
